purpose: Stronger validation of the previous conditionalHHI result, not a new outcome search
matching: same origin city, move year, recorded field, observed career-stage band, sufficient later publication observation
null: within each stratum pool cohort and other domestic events; randomly reassign cohort labels while fixing stratum cohort count. Conditional association null, not randomized treatment or causal identification
quantity: Exact finite-hypergeometric expectation of country destinationHHI, including count variance, compared with observed same-size cohortHHI
formula: EHHI = sum_k(sum_j n_j*p_jk)^2/N^2 + sum_j[n_j*(M_j-n_j)/(M_j-1)*(1-sum_k p_jk^2)]/N^2; singleton strata are deterministic
inference: country sign comparison and country-bootstrap interval for median relative deviation; no country-specific significance inferred from the expectation alone
sample: manuscript76 countries, main minimum100 domestic continuation records, sensitivity500; report strata without other reference events
information_scope: deidentified aggregated strata only exported for reproducibility; individuals remain temporary
reason: Earlier less-adjusted benchmark suggested selectivity; linear hierarchy results weakened with fuller adjustment, so the nonlinearHHI claim needs its own matched validation
